newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.150 cent. Cash markets holding stronger than expected.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Index down and corn seen higher but longer term projection still up.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Cash hogs seen up as hot and humid weather cuts runs. Pork products also higher but hog and pig report estimates may again press back months.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.200 to off 0.200 cent. Cash holding firm but ideas on out-of-town mostly bearish.
